verdict.rationale: Fly.io's Sprites checkpoint themselves while an agent works and can 'roll back to any checkpoint in seconds,' which gives snapshot-style versioning and rollback of an agent's environment. Nothing in the evidence shows reviewing or diffing changes, or versioning automation definitions themselves. missing for 10: explicit versioning of automation/workflow definitions, review or diff of changes before applying, deployment release history/rollback docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of checkpoint rollback.
